entities.summary: Tuomas Kiiskinen is a Finnish former professional ice hockey player who played most notably with KalPa in the Liiga. He also played for the Växjö Lakers and Skellefteå AIK of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). In 2015, Kiiskinen scored the goal that won Växjö the Le Mat Trophy in the second overtime against Skellefteå AIK.
